title: Ya ababdillah
body:
as salam ay shah-e-mazloom ghareebul ghuraba
ya ababdillah
kaash hote ye azadaar sar-e-karbobala
ya ababdillah
<<DIVIDER>>
ya ali keh ke sina kheench to li seene se
ay payambar zaade
khoon rulwaega lakhte dil e umme laila
ya ababdillah
as salaam ay…
<<DIVIDER>>
hasrat o yaas se tak'te thay haram suye furaat
kar ke abbas ko yaad
sar se zainab ke utari gayi jis waqt rida
ya ababdillah
as salaam ay…
<<DIVIDER>>
arsh hilta hai fiza mein hai tamachon ki sada
aasman kyun na gira
ek masoom ko milti hai yateemi ki saza
ya ababdillah
as salaam ay…
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ki yaad hai zindan hai namaze shab hai
aur bas zainab hai
tha dam e ruqsat aakhir yehi lab par nauha
ya ababdillah
as salaam ay…
<<DIVIDER>>
sadma e bewagi fatema kubra nahi kam
ban e qasim ki kasam
ek ye daag bhi ashoore ke din tune saha
ya ababdillah
as salaam ay…
<<DIVIDER>>
dafn ke baad bhi qabron ko laeen khodte hai
aur sar kaat te hai
farq e baysheer hai shahid sar-e-nauk e naiza
ya ababdillah
as salaam ay…
author: Shahid Jafer
